scripts.generate-blog: node scripts/generateBlog.mjs && prettier --ignore-path .prettierignore --write public/content/blog-index.json public/feed-*.xml public/blog/**/index.html && eslint --no-ignore public/content/blog-index.json
scripts.generate-projects: node scripts/generateProjects.mjs && prettier --ignore-path .prettierignore --write public/content/projects-index.json public/projects/**/index.html public/content/en_US/projects/*.md && eslint --no-ignore public/content/projects-index.json
scripts.generate-all: npm run generate-blog && npm run generate-projects && npm run generate-sitemaps && npm run generate-links
scripts.dev: npm run generate-all && npm run dev:basic
scripts.build: npm run generate-all && npm run lint && npm run test && vite build
scripts.build:basic: npm run lint && npm run test && vite build
